stories.headline: Perez Hilton recovering in hospital after reports he self-harmed during livestream - BBC
stories.summary: Miami police told US media outlets the celebrity blogger had been "safely recovered" from his home.
stories.why: Perez Hilton pioneered celebrity gossip blogging in the 2000s when you were discovering internet culture—his mental health crisis signals how that era's online personalities are aging into burnout, relevance loss, and real consequences.

stories.headline: Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis, charged with organizing the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur, is on trial - AP News
stories.summary: Nearly 30 years after his death, Tupac Shakur will be front and center as a man who prosecutors say orchestrated his killing goes to trial. Duane “Keffe D” Davis has pleaded not guilty to a single co…
stories.why: Tupac's murder trial closing a 30-year loop means the hip-hop mythology that shaped your teenage years is finally getting courtroom answers—this is the definitive ending to '90s rap's most unsolved chapter.

stories.headline: Phoebe Bridgers Makes Up for Lost Time on Her Long-Awaited New Album - Rolling Stone
stories.summary: Phoebe Bridgers' 'Lost Weekend,' her first new solo album in six years, is a spectacular song cycle on love and loss.
stories.why: Phoebe Bridgers is the indie-to-mainstream artist your generation made relevant; her return after 6 years signals whether the sad-girl aesthetic you grew up with still resonates or if the cultural moment has passed.

stories.headline: 'The Odyssey' Extends Run At Alex Theatre After Becoming Highest-Grossing 70MM Exhibitor Who Had Not Screened A New Movie In 35 Years - Deadline
stories.summary: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey continues to break records, and now the highest-grossing theater exhibiting the film in 70mm is extending its run.
stories.why: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' becoming a 70mm phenomenon on theater chains that haven't screened new movies in decades shows cinema blockbusters are still driving real-world cultural events—theater-going still matters.

stories.headline: Eli Roth Admits ‘Ice Cream Man’ Features AI-Assisted Shots After Suggesting Otherwise: ‘I Misspoke’ - Variety
stories.summary: The horror director said in a statement on Tuesday (via Polygon) that he used generative AI in “a very small portion of a few scenes in the film.”
stories.why: Eli Roth's AI confession after denying it reveals how quickly filmmakers will use generative AI and then backtrack when caught—this is the first major director getting publicly called out, setting a precedent for what you'll see in credits going forward.

stories.headline: ‘The Odyssey’ breakout actress reveals she hasn’t worked in a year due to her age: ‘At the end of the day, I’m 49’ - Page Six
stories.summary: The actress said she plans to continue to work until she’s in her 80s.
stories.why: A 49-year-old actress suddenly getting cast proves ageism in entertainment is real and structural; her visibility in 'The Odyssey' is breaking a decade-long wall that affects how you'll see older actors represented on screen.

stories.headline: Wizards Beyond Waverly Place Series Finale Reveals [Spoiler]'s Shocking Fate; David Henrie Says It Was The 'Cleanest' Choice - TVLine
stories.summary: Wizards Beyond Waverly Place star and EP David Henrie takes TVLine inside the dramatic series finale — including why one character didn't make it out alive.
stories.why: A character death in a Waverly Place spinoff targeting millennials is nostalgia content weaponized—this signals how streamers mine your childhood IP to create dramatic moments designed specifically for your emotional investment.
